sentences.text:
The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to set aside the judgment and decree dated 12.12.2007 passed by the court of Mr. S.S. Handa, Additional District Judge, Rohini Courts, Delhi in LAC bearing no. 250/2005 in respect of award bearing no.
2/2004-05 pertaining to the revenue estate of village Sawda, New Delhi.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Rohini Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the appellant by referring the impugned judgment and decree dated 12.12.2007 stated that the appellant was not given proper opportunity to lead evidence to claim enhanced compensation and referred in particular the para nos. 10 and 11 of the impugned judgment and decree This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/07/2024 at 23:14:27 dated 12.12.2007.

The counsel for the appellant further stated that the concerned reference court in respect of the same award has granted the enhanced compensation in LAC bearing no. 2032A/12 vide judgment dated 31.10.2014.
The counsel for the appellant prayed that the appellant be given an opportunity to lead evidence in support of his claim of enhanced compensation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The perusal of impugned judgment and decree dated 12.12.2007 reflects that the issue no. 2 regarding the entitlement of the appellant for enhanced compensation was decided against the appellant as the appellant had failed to adduce any evidence to prove the entitlement to receive enhanced compensation.

4. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel for the respondent no.1/Union of India stated that the appellant has failed to lead evidence before the reference court despite several opportunities and the appeal should not be remanded back by mere asking of the appellant.

It is further stated that the appeal bearing no. 337/2017 titled as Union of India V Maha Singh (Deceased) Through LRs pertaining to the same village and award preferred by the respondent no.1/Union of India is pending before this Court.
5.

entities.text: Union of India V Maha Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After considering all facts, the impugned judgment and decree dated 12.12.2007 is set aside and the appeal bearing LAC no. 250/2005 is remanded back to the concerned reference court for fresh decision after giving opportunity to the appellant to lead evidence on the date so fixed by the concerned reference court.
6. The appeal is accordingly disposed of.
7. The concerned parties are directed to appear before the reference This is a digitally signed order.
